'''Lenks''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] merchant who lived on [[Tython/Legends|Tython]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|resurgent Sith Empire]] and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].

==Biography==
A [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]], Lenks lived on the planet [[Tython/Legends|Tython]], where he ran a light armor-selling business located at the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order's]] [[Jedi Temple (Tython)/Legends|Temple]].<ref name="TOR" />
